comments.rawMarkdown:
I'm trying to set it up locally as well, but I'm also having trouble.
I downloaded the files from data and followed the steps in the README.me
That allows you to start an agent to run the games on the arc website.
If you change "OPERATION_MODE=ONLINE" to "OPERATION_MODE=OFFLINE" in the .env file and setup the environments_dir for the games "ENVIRONMENTS_DIR = "D:\ARC\environment_files".
You can run the games locally, BUT it doesnt seem to work correctly. I copied the stochastik goose model and it doesn't seem to learn anything. I can let it run for 20k steps without even beating a single level. I'm not sure what's causing this problem.
